meta.title: Delegation execution profiles
meta.description: Generate drafts with AI or manually maintain complete execution profiles (provider / model / effort) and a default. Review and confirm generated drafts before applying; manual edits are autosaved. The main Agent still picks a fixed profile directly for delegation, without extra per-task selection calls or switching the main Agent. Host authorization always applies. Supports freely named role/default presets over one globally shared available model pool, enabled state and limits.

config.ui: Delegation execution profile configuration (canonical ui entry; host authorization still applies)
config.auditFile: Absolute audit path, unique per running profile
